chunks: Al-Bazanti wrote to Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام concerning a man who died and left behind his daughter and his brother.
He said: “Give the wealth to the daughter if you do not fear anything from her paternal uncle.”

key_terms.الِابْنَةِ: the daughter, the direct female offspring heir
key_terms.تَرَكَ ابْنَتَهُ وَأَخَاهُ: left behind his daughter and his brother as surviving relatives

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام rule when a man died leaving a daughter and a brother?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning inheritance and the practical handling of an estate when a deceased man leaves behind a daughter and a brother. The Imam عليه السلام instructs that the property be given to the daughter, with caution noted regarding possible interference or harm from her paternal uncle.
